name: Human
flavor: Balanced and adaptable, humans excel through versatility rather than specialization.

name: Dwarf
flavor: Stout and enduring, dwarves are hard to move and harder to kill.

name: Elf
flavor: Nimble and long-lived, elves trade resilience for grace and speed.

name: Halfling
flavor: Small and quick, halflings rely on agility over armor.
